caption:
Prices rose 0.4% in October. 🧾

The BLS says food jumped 0.5% in the month, and shelter drove more than 30% of the overall increase.

Because of last year's government shutdown, there's no yearly rate for October. The last one, for September, was 3.7%.

Which bill hit your budget hardest this fall?
